verdict.rationale: n8n documents execution history/search and error-workflow handling for failures (n8n-docs-5, n8n-docs-9), and community feedback confirms historical executions are kept for debugging failed runs (n8n-comm-8). However, the evidence never explicitly describes a 'resume from failing step' re-run mechanism—only viewing logs and configuring an error workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/demo of re-running a failed execution from the exact failing node, and independent confirmation that this resume behavior works reliably in practice.
